questions.question_english: A teacher covered under CS(MA) Rules falls ill and gets treated by a private doctor who is not an AMA because the AMA was on leave and no substitute was available. What is the rule for reimbursement?
options_english: Complete denial of the medical claim under all circumstances due to non-compliance with rules
Reimbursable as a special case by the HOD if AMA unavailability and emergency are established
The claim is rejected and the teacher must pay a departmental fine equal to the billed amount
The reimbursement claim is forwarded to the Prime Minister’s Relief Fund for compassionate payment
questions.explanation_english: Reimbursable as a special case by the HOD if AMA unavailability and emergency are established. When an employee falls ill in a non-scheme area and the designated Authorised Medical Attendant is absent without a substitute, seeking care from another registered doctor is permissible in emergencies. The Head of Department can exercise discretionary relaxation to sanction reimbursement upon verification of emergency necessity and official AMA unavailability.

key_facts: Answer key: (B)
